_comment: PANT-1278: which Heimdall lane (GET /lanes lane_id) each Multica agent runs on, keyed by Multica agent ID (not name: names repeat across tenants, e.g. flayr-review is a codex agent in one workspace and a claude-review agent in firefly-events). Values are agent labels for humans only. Mirrors pantheon-v2's pantheon.lane-runners.yaml (the map core-api's LaneBreaker uses) plus the codex and gemini agents it lacks. Override or extend with AGENT_LANES in AURIGA_CONFIG (name- or ID-keyed, that wins) or point AURIGA_AGENT_LANES_FILE at another file. An agent with no entry here stays eligible whatever Heimdall says.
